name: APPEAL_GRV
description: This table contains information about an individual appeal or grievance.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: CM_LOG_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance from which this record or line was extracted. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the record status (hidden, soft-deleted, etc.).

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of request this record represents. This is either an appeal or grievance.

columns.name: SERIES_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The series ID for the appeal/grievance. This value is shared across levels of appeal/grievance.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The identifier assigned to an appeal/grievance by an external entity.

columns.name: INITIATED_BY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of person which initiated the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: INITIATING_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: INITIATING_REP_MEM_RESP_GUID
columns.description: If this record was initiated by an authorized representative this stores their Member Responsible GUID from the member's coverage.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_METHOD_C_NAME
columns.description: How this appeal or grievance was submitted.

columns.name: REVIEW_LEVEL_C_NAME
columns.description: The level of review within the appeals process.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The member associated with the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: APPEAL_SUBJECT_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: What the appeal was filed about. This is either an authorization or a claim.

columns.name: SUBJECT_AUTH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Authorization that is being appealed or grieved about.

columns.name: SUBJECT_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The claim being appealed or grieved about.

columns.name: RESULT_AUTH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The authorization created to effectuate the appeal decision in Epic.

columns.name: RESULT_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The resulting claim for the appeal.

columns.name: RECORD_CREATE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant that this record was created.

columns.name: RECORD_CREATE_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the user who created this record.

columns.name: RECORD_CREATE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: URGENCY_C_NAME
columns.description: The urgency of the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_OVRIDE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: If Submission System Instant (UTC) (I TAG 10010) is incorrect, this stores the override. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: DECISION_SYS_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time that a decision was made for the appeal or grievance. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: DECISION_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the user that finalized the appeal decision.

columns.name: DECISION_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: DECISION_OVRIDE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: If the System Calculated Decision Instant (UTC) (I TAG 10100) is incorrect, this will store the override. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: APPEAL_DECISION_C_NAME
columns.description: The decision for the appeal.

columns.name: TIMEFRAME_START_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The earliest date and time across all relevant timeliness standards that the clock for processing the appeal ot grievance begins based on the table APPEAL_GRV_TAT_MILESTONES. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_RPT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The compiled date and time an appeal or grievance was submitted to the organization. Equal to the Organization Submission instant (UTC) - Override (I TAG 10011) if it is set, otherwise Organization Submission instant (UTC) (I TAG 10010). Stored in UTC.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_SYS_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time that the appeal or grievance was submitted to the organization. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EXP_REQ_REC_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the request to expedite was received. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: WAS_UPGRADED_TO_EXP_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the urgency was changed from standard to expedited for this appeal or grievance. 'Y' indicates that the appeal or grievance was initially submitted with a standard urgency and then later upgraded to an expedited urgency. 'N' or NULL indicates that either the appeal or grievance was initially submitted with an expedited urgency, or the appeal or grievance was initially submitted with a standard priority, and the priority is still standard.

columns.name: EXP_REQ_DEC_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that a decision was made on whether to upgrade the appeal or grievance to an expedited priority. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EXT_REQ_REC_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the request to extend the timeframe was received. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EXT_DAYS
columns.description: The number of days the deadline for the appeal or grievance was extended.

columns.name: EXT_REQ_DEC_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the decision was made on whether to extend the timeframe. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EXT_MAX_DAYS
columns.description: The maximum number of days the deadline can be extended.

columns.name: EFFECT_SYS_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time for when the appeal was effectuated. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EFFECT_OVR_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: If Effectuation System Instant (UTC) (I TAG 10050) is incorrect, this will store the override. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EFFECT_RPT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The compiled date and time an was effectuated. Equal to the Effectuation override instant (UTC) (I TAG 10051) if it is set, otherwise Effectuation system instant (UTC) (I TAG 10050). Stored in UTC.

columns.name: EFFECT_DUE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time an appeal must be effectuated in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: OVERALL_DUE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that the appeal or grievance must be fully completed in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: DECISION_RPT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that a decision was made for an appeal or grievance. Equal to Decision Instant (UTC) - Override (I TAG 10101) if it is set, otherwise Decision Instant (UTC) (I TAG 10100). Stored in UTC.

columns.name: DECISION_DUE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time a decision must be made on an appeal or grievance in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: TAT_SYS_TIME_ZONE_C_NAME
columns.description: The system calculated time zone category ID to use for TAT calculations based on the time zone of where the appeal/grievance record was created.

columns.name: TAT_OVR_TIME_ZONE_C_NAME
columns.description: If TAT system time zone (I TAG 10500) is incorrect, this will store the category ID of the override.

columns.name: TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C_NAME
columns.description: The compiled time zone category ID to use for TAT calculations. Equal to TAT Override Time Zone (I TAG 10501) if it is set, otherwise TAT System Time Zone (I TAG 10500).

columns.name: TIMEFRAME_START_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The earliest date and time across all relevant timeliness standards that the clock for processing the appeal or grievance begins based on the table APPEAL_GRV_TAT_MILESTONES. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_SYS_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time that the appeal or grievance was submitted to the organization. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_OVR_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: If Submission System Instant (I TAG 10910) is incorrect, this stores the override. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_RPT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The compiled date and time an appeal or grievance was submitted to the organization. Equal to the Organization Submission instant - Override (I TAG 10911) if it is set, otherwise Organization Submission instant (I TAG 10910). Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EXP_REQ_REC_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the request to expedite was received. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EXP_DEC_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that a decision was made on whether to upgrade the appeal or grievance to an expedited priority. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EXT_REQ_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the request to extend the timeframe was received. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EXT_DEC_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time the decision was made on whether to extend the timeframe. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EFFECT_SYS_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time for when the appeal was effectuated. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EFFECT_OVR_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: If Effectuation System Instant (I TAG 10950) is incorrect, this will store the override. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EFFECT_RPT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The compiled date and time an appeal was effectuated. Equal to the Effectuation override instant (I TAG 10951) if it is set, otherwise Effectuation system instant (I TAG 10950). Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EFFECT_DUE_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time an appeal must be effectuated in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: OVERALL_DUE_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that the appeal or grievance must be fully completed in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: DECISION_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The system calculated date and time that a decision was made for the appeal or grievance. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: DECISION_OVR_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: If the System Calculated Decision Instant (I TAG 10990) is incorrect, this will store the override. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: DECISION_RPT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that a decision was made for an appeal or grievance. Equal to Decision Instant - Override (I TAG 10991) if it is set, otherwise Decision Instant (I TAG 10990). Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: DECISION_DUE_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time a decision must be made on an appeal or grievance in order to stay compliant with all timeliness standards. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: GRIEVANCE_SUBJECT_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The subject type category ID for the grievance. This specifies what the grievance is about.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_GRIEVANCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The reason category ID for the grievance.

columns.name: SUBJECT_APPEAL_APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the appeal that is the subject of this grievance.

columns.name: SUBJECT_GRIEVANC_APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the grievance that is the subject of this grievance.

columns.name: SUBJECT_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_FACILITY_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_EMPLOYEE_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the employee that is the subject of this grievance.

columns.name: SUBJECT_EMPLOYEE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: SUBJECT_RESOURCE_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_LOC_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_POS_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_BUS_SEG_POS_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_REGION_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_GROUP_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the coverage related to this grievance.

columns.name: GRIEVANCE_INCIDENT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC date and time that the incident occurred for this grievance.

columns.name: GRIEVANCE_INCIDENT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The local date and time that the incident occurred for this grievance. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: EXTENSION_INITIATED_BY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Whether the extension was initiated by the health plan, or the appeal or grievance submitter.

columns.name: DECISION_OVR_USER_ID
columns.description: If the Decision User ID System (I TAG 10103) is incorrect, this will store the override value.

columns.name: DECISION_OVR_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: DECISION_RPT_USER_ID
columns.description: Stores the Decision User ID Override (I TAG 10104) if it is set. Otherwise stores the Decision User ID System (I TAG 10103).

columns.name: DECISION_RPT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: LATE_FILING_RCV_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant, in UTC, when the reasons for late filing were received.

columns.name: FILED_ON_TIME_C_NAME
columns.description: The on time status category ID for the appeal/grievance.

columns.name: AG_REVIEW_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: If the appeal/grievance is being reviewed internally or externally.

columns.name: REVIEW_AGENCY_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the agency responsible for processing the appeal/grievance.

columns.name: REVIEW_AGENCY_ID_AGENCY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the agency.

columns.name: CASE_SENT_REVW_ENTITY_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC date and time that the appeal/grievance case file information was sent to the review entity.

columns.name: CASE_SENT_REVW_ENTY_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The local date and time that the appeal/grievance case file information was sent to the review entity. Stored in the time zone determined by column TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the coverage associated with the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: PAYER_ID_PAYOR_NAME
columns.description: The name of the payor.

columns.name: BENEFIT_PLAN_ID_BENEFIT_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: The name of the benefit plan record.

columns.name: LOB_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the line of business associated with the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: LOB_ID_LOB_NAME
columns.description: The name of the line of business record.

columns.name: MC_PEER_GROUP_C_NAME
columns.description: The category ID of the managed care peer group of the coverage associated with the appeal or grievance.

columns.name: REGION_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: MEDICAL_GROUP_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SUBJECT_FREE_TEXT
columns.description: Stores the name and/or the ID of the subject of the grievance, if the subject is not a record in Epic.
